item.title: Website
item.overviewNarrative: Full-stack responsive application development and delivery.
item.description: Full-stack responsive application development and delivery.
item.subdesc: Design, development & delivery of web and mobile applications for the product, provided to naveen
item.sec4Subtitle: Two engagement options are proposed based on platform reach. Both plans deliver the complete feature set listed in Section 3.
item.planAHighlights:
Responsive web application (Customer, Merchant & Admin portals)
All core features from Section 3
Secure payment gateway integration (Card / UPI)
QR-based ticket check-in (web scanner)
Admin & Merchant dashboards
Cross-browser, mobile-responsive UI
Basic SEO setup & deployment
item.planBHighlights:
Everything in Plan A, plus:
Native/hybrid mobile apps for Customer & Merchant (Android + iOS)
Push notifications for promotions & alerts
In-app QR scanner for on-site check-in
Mobile-optimized chat & booking flow
App Store & Play Store submission support
item.paymentTerms: 50% Advance upon signing proposal, 50% upon deployment.
item.termsAndConditions:
Estimation is valid for 30 days from the date of this document.
Timeline: Plan A — approx. 6–8 weeks; Plan B — approx. 10–12 weeks from kick-off.
Cost excludes third-party charges such as payment gateway fees, SMS/email fees.
Includes 30 days of complimentary post-launch bug-fix support.
item.inclusions:
Full source code and deployment credentials handover upon final settlement.
Complimentary 30-day post-deployment bug-fix technical support.
Production server deployment, SSL configuration & DNS domain mapping.
item.exclusions:
Third-party API charges (SMS, WhatsApp API, Payment Gateway fees).
Google Play ($25) & Apple Developer ($99/year) console registration fees.
Content copywriting, stock video/image purchasing.

customFeatures.description: Instant status updates, SMS alerts, and database activity tracking.

customFeatures.description: Comprehensive reporting analytics, user roles, and order tracking.
